description: This file defines extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure AWS DynamoDB storage as grain storage in an Orleans application. It provides methods to set DynamoDB as default storage or for specific named storages, along with related options and validators.

classes.name: DynamoDBGrainStorageServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for configuring DynamoDB grain storage services within the dependency injection container.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the service collection to use AWS DynamoDB storage as the default grain storage with a configuration action.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the service collection to use AWS DynamoDB storage with a specified name and configuration action.
